verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Internal Agent can be prompted for a report on how the Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short. Automations can also watch tools and the support queue and surface gaps on their own, and the agent analyzes resolved tickets to build configurations. That is first-party AI-generated insight from the customer's support data inside the product. However, explicit actionable suggestions and the depth of the reports are only implied, and all evidence is vendor documentation. Missing for 10: documented AI suggestions/recommendations beyond gap identification, detail on report content and data scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short.
Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.
the Internal Agent analyzes your last 500-1,000 resolved tickets along with your existing context to build the first version of your Customer Agent
